dogecoin.text: Big news: First U.S. XRP ETF launches today! XRP & Dogecoin surge 10% in a relief rally. Liquidity boost incoming, but Coindesk 20 index drops 13.5%. Mixed signals—stay sharp! #XRP #CryptoMarket

A dogecoin ETF? 21Shares just made its move 🚀

—The firm filed for a spot DOGE ETF with the SEC and partnered with the Dogecoin Foundation and the House of Doge.
—Grayscale and Bitwise have already applied, but 21Shares’ partnership may give it an edge.
—The SEC’s softer stance

The SEC has pushed its decision on Franklin Templeton’s XRP ETF to June 17, 2025 ⏳📉. The delay aligns with broader crypto regulatory caution, while Bitwise’s Dogecoin ETF faces a similar postponement.  

- XRP ETF ruling delayed to mid-June for further SEC review.
